name: kesher
description: Local-first, open-source desktop app that runs every kind of AI model — chat, image, video, audio — in one place.

scripts.build:packages: tsc -b packages/shared packages/providers packages/downloads packages/plugin-sdk packages/skills packages/agent packages/core plugins/example-hello
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @kesher/web build && pnpm --filter @kesher/desktop build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @kesher/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @kesher/desktop typecheck
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist plugins/*/dist apps/*/dist apps/*/out packages/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo plugins/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
